units.source_text: 我回来时，K的枕边已经点上了香。

en.t: When I returned, incense had already been lit beside K's pillow.

units.source_text: 刚一进屋，立刻闻到一股佛堂般的熏香味，只见夫人和小姐坐在缭绕的烟雾中。

en.t: As soon as I entered the room, I smelled incense like that of a Buddhist hall, and saw the mistress and the young lady sitting amid the curling smoke.

units.source_text: 从昨晚到现在，我还是第一次见到小姐。

en.t: This was the first time I had seen the young lady since the previous night.

units.source_text: 小姐在哭泣，夫人的眼睛也是红红的。

en.t: The young lady was crying, and the mistress's eyes were red as well.

units.source_text: 从事情发生到现在，竟忘却了哭泣的我，直到此时才终于被勾起了伤悲。

en.t: I, who had forgotten even to weep since the incident occurred, was only then finally drawn into grief.

units.source_text: 我不知这痛哭流涕使自己的心情得到了多少宽慰。

en.t: I do not know how much comfort that sobbing brought to my heart.

units.source_text: 但是，给予我那被痛苦和恐怖紧紧攫住的心灵一滴甘露的，正是那时的悲哀。

en.t: But what gave a drop of nectar to my heart, gripped tightly by pain and terror, was precisely the sorrow of that moment.

units.source_text: 我默默地在她们身旁坐了下来。

en.t: I silently sat down beside them.

units.source_text: 夫人要我也上线香，我上过香，又默默地坐下来。

en.t: The mistress asked me to offer incense too; after I had done so, I sat down again in silence.

units.source_text: 小姐没有对我说什么，虽偶尔同夫人交谈一两句，也是有关眼下的一些事情，

en.t: The young lady said nothing to me, and even when she occasionally exchanged a word or two with the mistress, it was only about immediate matters at hand,

units.source_text: 小姐此时还没有心情去谈论K生前的事。

en.t: the young lady still had no heart then to talk about K while he was alive.

units.source_text: 我心中暗想：没让她看见昨晚那可怕的情景，真是做对了。

en.t: In my heart I thought that it had truly been right not to let her see the terrible scene of the night before.

units.source_text: 我担心年轻美貌的女人看到那幅可怕的景象，会伤其美色。

en.t: I feared that if a young and beautiful woman saw that dreadful sight, it would damage her beauty.

units.source_text: 即便我恐惧得已经毛发倒竖之时，也不能将这种念头置之度外去行事。

en.t: Even when fear had made my hair stand on end, I could not act while setting that thought aside.

units.source_text: 因为对我而言，这就仿佛无缘无故地鞭挞一朵娇艳的鲜花一般，无法忍受。

en.t: For to me, it was unbearable, as if I were whipping a lovely flower for no reason at all.
